records.title: BADVEL-NELLORE NEW FOUR-LANE PROJECT.
details:
a to b: Yes, Sir. Government has accorded approval for the development 4-Lane Badvel-Nellore Highway from Badvel-Gopavaram Village on National for implementation of the project on Build-Operate-Transfer (Toll) mode for a Highway NH-67 to Guruvindapudi on NH-16 in the State of Andhra Pradesh total length of 108.134 km and with a total capital cost of Rs.3653.10 crore.
(d) The development of project is projected to generate 20 lakh person-days of direct employment and 23 lakh-person days of indirect employment. The project will also induce additional employment opportunities due to increase in economic activity in the vicinity of the proposed road.

records.title: Sewage and Septage Management in Kavali City.
details: a to d: One project worth ₹13.49 crore is at implementation stage.

records.title: Duration of B.Ed. course.
details: d: As mandated by NEP 2020, the draft NCTE Regulations 2025 envisage the institutions providing B.Ed. to become multidisciplinary institutions by 2028. Since the NCTE Regulations, 2025 are at draft stage, the applications have not been invited.

records.title: STATUS OF ROBs/RUBs IN NELLORE DISTRICT, ANDHRA PRADESH.
details: Presently, 12 Nos. ROBs/RUBs works are sanctioned in Nellore district, which are at various stages of planning and execution.

records.title: Sanction of ESI Hospital
details: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has given in-principle approval on 05.03.2018 for setting up of a 100-bedded ESI hospital in Sri City of district of Nellore (Andhra Pradesh)

records.title: Agriculture Reforms and GST
details: Part (a) [Please see Annexure]: Point No. 12:- B) Contract cultivation of other high value crops such as Perila, black thai ginger and Calandula flowers is under process. Point No. 12:- C) Therefore, to achieve the vision of Hon’ble PM and Budget Announcement, a dedicated centrally sponsored schemes “National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)” is being launched. Committee of Secretaries (CoS) and Expenditure Finance Committee (EFC) has recommended the launching of NMNF. A Cabinet Note to roll out NMNF is under process. Point No. 31:- For better planning, monitoring, policy making, strategy formulation and smooth implementation of schemes a federated architecture is being developed.
